description: 인천항만공사_항만출입통제시스템 인원정보 조회 서비스 [ports and harbours] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 인천항만공사. 해당 자료는 항만 내 인원 출입 통제와 관련된 등록번호, 등록상태, 정보변경일, 인원구분, 소속구분, PA적재역무, 등록기관, 이동정보 여부, 등록일시, 수정일시 등의 항목을 포함하고. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 인천항만공사. Its tags are 항만출입통제, 인원정보, 보안정보, 출입등록, 등록상태코드. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-04-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
